For a future collaborator

Find a problem worth working on together.

I am interested in developer tools, data workflows and processes that make people repeatedly move information between systems. A useful starting point is a concrete situation: what someone is trying to do, where they get stuck and what a good result should look like.

Tell me about the problem ↗

01

What I can contribute

Backend systems, APIs, data processing and integrations, connected to a web or mobile interface when the task needs one. CODY shows how I bring several parts of a system together. BPMN.space shows a team-built tool that helps clarify a problem rather than simply generate an answer.

02

If we are building together

I suggest starting with one scenario, agreeing on responsibilities and producing a working version early. Clear decisions and a way to check the outcome matter to me. A research question, an unfinished prototype or a well-defined problem can all be a reason to begin a conversation.

03

If you need a paid pilot

We can scope one workflow, examine inputs and exceptions, agree on examples of success and build a limited pilot. Timing and scope follow that initial review. A first message only needs three things: what happens today, what you want to change and an example of the result you would like to discuss.

For a concrete project

One workflow.
One reliable pilot.

We can take one repetitive operation and build a focused integration: source → validation → action → visible result. We agree on scope and acceptance criteria before development.
